title: High Availability virtual-server parity deepening (IPVS virtual-server + real-server CRUD)
acceptance_criteria: `/network/high-availability` supports form-driven CRUD for `high-availability virtual-server` entries.
Nested real-server CRUD supports `port`, `connection-timeout`, and `health-check script` leaves.
Save path emits diff-based set/delete operations for both VRRP and virtual-server subtrees without API contract changes.
Validation passes: backend test_app, frontend tsc/lint/build, runtime smoke, and browser smoke.
assumptions: Existing backend high-availability tree wrapper is sufficient for virtual-server operations.
Virtual-server names use token forms aligned with current VyOS documentation examples.
Unrelated dirty files in this worktree remain untouched.

tasks.notes: Added virtual-server + real-server CRUD sections and integrated state parsing from config tree.
No backend changes required; existing scoped config-tree wrapper already supports this subtree.
Validated via backend pytest, frontend tsc/lint/build, runtime smoke, and UI smoke.
Manual review completed in-session; no blocking issues found.
